title: "Album Analysis"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(knitr)

# Load album data and unnest track details
albums <- fromJSON("albums_data.json")

songs <- albums |>
  select(artist, album, genre, tracks) |>
  unnest(tracks) |>
  mutate(duration_min = round(duration_sec / 60, 2))
```

This page analyzes track counts, song durations, and highlights from our K-pop album collection.

## Album Overview

```{r}
album_summary <- songs |>
  group_by(Artist = artist, Album = album, Genre = genre) |>
  summarize(
    `Total Tracks` = n(),
    `Avg Length (min)` = round(mean(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    `Fan Favorite` = track_name[is_favorite][1],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

kable(album_summary)
```

## Track Counts by Album

How do our selected albums compare in size?

```{r}
album_summary |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Album, `Total Tracks`), y = `Total Tracks`, fill = Artist)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = `Total Tracks`), hjust = -0.3, size = 3.8) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Tracks per Album",
    subtitle = "Full-length albums vs. EPs and singles",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Track Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

## Song Durations

How long are the songs on each album?

```{r}
songs |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(album, duration_min, FUN = median), y = duration_min, color = artist)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2.5, alpha = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Song Duration Distribution by Album",
    subtitle = "Track length in minutes across projects",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Duration (minutes)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```
